crossRefs.note: Now when the day of Pentecost had come, they were all with one accord in one place.
while you stretch out your hand to heal; and that signs and wonders may be done through the name of your holy Servant…
By the hands of the apostles many signs and wonders were done among the people. They were all with one accord in…
Therefore those who were scattered abroad went around preaching the word.
Therefore they stayed there a long time, speaking boldly in the Lord, who testified to the word of his grace, granting…
At Lystra a certain man sat, impotent in his feet, a cripple from his mother’s womb, who never had walked.
in the power of signs and wonders, in the power of God’s Spirit; so that from Jerusalem, and around as far as to…
My speech and my preaching were not in persuasive words of human wisdom, but in demonstration of the Spirit and of…
that your faith wouldn’t stand in the wisdom of men, but in the power of God.
I planted. Apollos watered. But God gave the increase.
Working together, we entreat also that you do not receive the grace of God in vain,
God also testifying with them, both by signs and wonders, by various works of power and by gifts of the Holy Spirit…

translations.web: They went out, and preached everywhere, the Lord working with them, and confirming the word by the signs that followed. Amen.
translations.bsb: And they went out and preached everywhere, and the Lord worked through them, confirming His word by the signs that accompanied it.
translations.kjv: And they went forth, and preached every where, the Lord working with them, and confirming the word with signs following. Amen.
translations.asv: And they went forth, and preached everywhere, the Lord working with them, and confirming the word by the signs that followed. Amen.
